statistical_review.simpson: Domains, old512 and two new batches separately retained; no pooled winner.
statistical_review.ecological: Mean benefit does not imply every-user benefit; paired gains/losses saved.
statistical_review.berkson: Pre-existing fixed hash sample of eligible validation, not raw population.
statistical_review.collider: No target- or hit-based sample selection.
statistical_review.regression_to_mean: Old512 selected repeatedly; second new batch needed before interpreting first-batch means.
statistical_review.survivorship: All11 arms included on every analyzed user; later incomplete tail ignored by fixed count.
statistical_review.look_elsewhere: All paired comparisons saved; unadjusted descriptive intervals, no confirmatory significance.
statistical_review.forking_paths: Scope reduced after observing first-batch results; explicitly exploratory, no automatic early elimination.
statistical_review.causation: Contributions conditional on original10 fuser and current frozen decoder, not intrinsic model quality.
statistical_review.reverse_causality: No new features, fits or target-driven sampling.
